text: {"assertions":["A crash loop in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml was debugged on 2026-01-24, with the root cause being missing Unicode normalisation before hashing.","The crash loop manifested only on the staging read replica when rolled out to the small node pool.","The crash loop symptom was containers restarting a few seconds after startup.","The fix involved normalising Unicode strings to NFC before calculating the digest.","The fix was submitted as PR #3582 on branch fix/crash-loop-1.","After applying the fix, memory usage stabilized at 535 MB instead of exceeding 8 GB.","This crash loop issue occurred in the same area of infra/k8s/deployment.yaml as a previous crash loop problem."]}
